radiology_report:
Department of Radiology
UMCG (Groningen)
Date: 21 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 4.8 ng/mL, prior negative biopsy, PI-RADS assessment requested.
FINDINGS: The prostate measures 68.0 mL in volume. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal area of low signal intensity in the left peripheral zone, posterior aspect. This lesion demonstrates restricted diffusion on DWI (high signal on b=1400) and early enhancement on DCE, consistent with a PI-RADS v2.1 category 4 lesion. The approximate size of the lesion is 12 mm in maximal dimension. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone. Prostate volume 68.0 mL, PSA density 0.07 ng/mL/mL. Clinical stage cT2a. csPCa predicted probability 0.800129.

previous_notes.author: Dr. M. Jansen (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient attended for routine follow-up. PSA was checked and found to be 4.8 ng/mL, representing a rise from the previous value of 3.5 ng/mL in Jan 2024. Given the increasing PSA trend and the prior negative biopsy result, a multiparametric MRI was arranged at UMCG to further evaluate the prostate. The patient was advised to discuss the MRI results with the urology team.

previous_notes.author: Dr. M. Jansen (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient presented with mild lower urinary tract symptoms. PSA was measured at 3.5 ng/mL. Digital rectal examination was unremarkable. A systematic prostate biopsy was performed, which returned negative for malignancy. The patient was advised to continue monitoring PSA levels annually and to report any new symptoms.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1: Histological examination of the prostate tissue specimens reveals benign prostatic tissue. The Gleason score is reported as 0+0, corresponding to ISUP grade group 0. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. Perineural invasion is not seen.

Summary: The biopsy findings have remained stable across the single timepoint, with no evidence of malignancy or high-risk features.
